The **events log** shows two residents (`local-218`, `local-250`) using `public-search` with `public-web-read` capability, but: - No **date filtering** is applied in the frontier questions. - No **geopolitical exclusion rules** are enforced (e.g., distinguishing Jordanian vs. U.S./Russian/Syrian airstrikes). - The **rejected analysis** (event 2054-208) suggests a **bounded follow-up** was attempted but discarded—yet the **criteria for rejection are not documented**. 3.
